name: Chrono Cards
storyline: You and a rival time traveler are locked in an existential battle to the death, and only one Timeline can emerge unscathed. Draw on the most powerful characters, creatures, inventions and events from across history as well as your own time traveling abilities to defeat your opponent. You may even encounter hybrid cards which mash together eras that normally would never have existed at the same time...but with time travel involved, all bets are off.
summary: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.
